question.text:
§

How does glucose induce insulin release?

answer.text:
§
How does glucose induce insulin release?

Closes ATP dependent K+ channels

↑ Glucose

⇒ ↑ Aerobic respiration

⇒ ↑ ATP

⇒ Closure of ATP gated K+ efflux channels

⇒ ↑ Membrane voltage

⇒ Opening of voltage gated Ca2+ channels

⇒ Ca2+ influx

⇒ Exocytosis of insulin
